title: Tetranychus cinnabarinus on green bean - China

Header: Tetranychus cinnabarinus on green bean - China

Prevention: Remove weeds in/around the field to reduce overwintering population.
Proper irrigation, increase application of phosphate to strengthen resistance.
Water-stressed plants stimulate spider mite outbreaks; be sure to keep the crop properly irrigated.
Monitoring: Monitoring should be carried out after transplanting, could be combined together with other pests throughout growth period.
August; during this time, monitoring should be conducted more often and carefully.
When occurs sporadically in the field, direct control should be carried out.
Direct Control: Remove old leaves and egg masses.
Preserve natural enemies of mites by avoiding early season, broad- spectrum insecticide applications.
The most important predators early in the season are the western flower thrips.
Later, big-eyed bugs, minute pirate bugs, predaceous mites, and other predators are also important.
Restrictions: Chemical pesticides must be applied strictly according to the prescribed dosages to avoid residue problems.
Rotational application of pesticides to avoid resistance.
WHO III, Apply during early stage; maximum 2 sprays for each growing season, PHI: 14 days
